content.text: The relational repository has the spread order reversed: the existing entity overrides the payload.

candidates.explanation: The merge is `{...payload, ...UserMapper.toDomain(entity)}`. The existing entity is spread last, so its current values (firstName, lastName, role, and so on) overwrite the incoming payload. The save therefore writes the old values back. The request returns 200 with the unchanged user, and the database is not modified. The document repository does this correctly, with the payload spread last.

fix.description: Spread the payload after the existing domain entity so payload values take precedence. Also drop undefined values and the id from the payload, so unset fields don't overwrite existing ones.
